Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the great session last week. A handful of our registrants (about 25) reported they never received the follow-up email with the trial codes; several of them bought a ticket but had corporate filters that delayed delivery.

Could Redwood make a one-time exception and issue replacement 7-day trial promo codes for these attendees? Ideally we get the codes by Monday so we can include them in our post-event wrap-up.

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for flagging this. We can support a one-time issuance for late-claim attendees but I need Ops and Finance to sign off on the operational and cost side.

Grace —

Quick cost check: our list-based promo codes are accounted for in the campaign bucket. If we issue new single-use 7-day trial codes, the unit marginal cost is primarily the hosting/credits delta and is approx $15 per activated trial-day in our internal estimate for this campaign (conservative). For 25 codes that would be ~ $375 of backend usage exposure, plus administrative overhead.

If we absorb up to 20 as a courtesy, incremental cost to Redwood ~ $300. Anything >20, we'll need written underwriting from BrightLearn for the excess. Also confirm whether codes should be for the same product tier as the original campaign.
